title: Pure Counter Fairy
summary: Pure Counter Fairy control build combining the Parshath engine, Guiding Ariadne, and a full suite of Counter Traps. Guiding Ariadne waives all LP and discard costs for Counter Traps, while Bountiful Artemis, Minerva, Meltiel, and Power Angel Valkyria convert every Counter Trap resolution into card advantage and board removal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ties of the Brethren pays 2000 LP targeting a Level 4 LIGHT Fairy you control to Special Summon two more with different names from the Deck, fielding Bountiful Artemis, Minerva, Scholar of the Sky, and Meltiel, Sage of the Sky at once.
Guiding Ariadne in the Pendulum Zone removes all LP payments and discard costs needed to activate Counter Traps, and reveals 3 Counter Traps from the Deck when destroyed so one is added to your hand.

The Sanctum of Parshath is treated as The Sanctuary in the Sky on the field or in the GY, shields all Set Spells and Traps from targeting and effect destruction, and recycles 3 Fairies and/or Counter Traps from the GY to the top of the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy + Ties of the Brethren
steps: Place Guiding Ariadne in the Pendulum Zone (if drawn) and Normal Summon Bountiful Artemis, Minerva, or Meltiel.

Activate Ties of the Brethren, paying 2000 LP to Special Summon the other two Level 4 LIGHT Counter Fairies from the Deck (locking you out of Special Summons and your Battle Phase for the rest of the turn).

Activate The Sanctum of Parshath to protect your backrow and turn on Sanctuary bonus effects, then Set your Counter Traps to draw, recover, and pop cards on every activation during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Counter Fairy Payoffs
points: Bountiful Artemis draws 1 card immediately every time a Counter Trap resolves.
Minerva, Scholar of the Sky gains 500 ATK on every Counter Trap activation and adds a differently named Counter Trap from the GY to your hand while The Sanctuary in the Sky (or Sanctum) is active.

Meltiel, Sage of the Sky gains 1000 LP per Counter Trap and destroys 1 card the opponent controls while Sanctuary is on the field, and Power Angel Valkyria searches any LIGHT Fairy once per turn when you negate an activation or Summon.

summary.title: Bosses & Counter Traps
points: Rebirth of Parshath reveals a Counter Trap in hand to negate any card or effect, shuffles it into the Deck, and Special Summons Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath from the Deck or Extra Deck or Avenging Knight Parshath from the Extra Deck.

Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath can also banish 2 Fairies (or discard 2 Counter Traps) on a Counter Trap activation to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY, and searches a Parshath card or Counter Trap when it inflicts piercing battle damage.
Divine Punishment, Solemn Judgment, Solemn Strike, Solemn Warning, Ultimate Providence, and Drastic Drop Off become completely free negations under Guiding Ariadne and The Sanctum of Parshath.

allow.Ties of the Brethren: Pays 2000 LP to summon Bountiful Artemis and Minerva, Scholar of the Sky directly from the Deck alongside Guiding Ariadne.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Iconic Counter Trap whose half-LP cost is completely bypassed while Guiding Ariadne is in the Pendulum Zone.
allow.Solemn Strike: Counter Trap that negates monster effects or Special Summons for free under Guiding Ariadne.
allow.Solemn Warning: Counter Trap that negates any Summon or effect that Special Summons.
allow.Ultimate Providence: Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or Monster effect without discarding while Guiding Ariadne is active.
allow.Drastic Drop Off: Counter Trap that forces the opponent to discard the card they just drew or added to their hand.

main: Bountiful Artemis
Core Counter Fairy that draws 1 card immediately every time a Counter Trap Card is resolved.
Guiding Ariadne
Pendulum Scale that removes all LP costs and discard costs for activating Counter Traps, and reveals 3 Counter Traps from the Deck when destroyed so the opponent adds 1 to your hand.
Minerva, Scholar of the Sky
Gains 500 ATK every time a Counter Trap is activated and adds 1 Counter Trap with a different name from your GY to your hand while The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field.
Meltiel, Sage of the Sky
Gains 1000 LP every time a Counter Trap is resolved, and destroys 1 card the opponent controls if The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field.
Power Angel Valkyria
Searches any LIGHT Fairy monster from the Deck once per turn whenever you negate the activation of a card/effect or a Summon.
Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath
Boss monster that Special Summons itself from hand or GY when you activate a Counter Trap and searches a Parshath or Counter Trap on battle damage.
The Sanctum of Parshath
Continuous Spell treated as The Sanctuary in the Sky that protects Set Spells/Traps from targeting/destruction and recycles 3 Fairies/Counter Traps to the top of the Deck.
Ties of the Brethren
Turns 1 Level 4 LIGHT Fairy into a full board of Artemis, Minerva, and Meltiel.
Rebirth of Parshath
Signature Counter Trap that reveals a Counter Trap to negate ANY card/effect, shuffles it into the Deck, and cheats out Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath or Avenging Knight Parshath.
Divine Punishment
Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect at zero cost while The Sanctuary in the Sky (or The Sanctum of Parshath) is on the field.
Solemn Judgment
Negates any Summon or Spell/Trap activation, triggering Artemis, Minerva, and Meltiel simultaneously.
Solemn Strike
Negates any monster effect or Special Summon, triggering all Counter Fairy effects.
Solemn Warning
Negates a Summon or Special Summon effect.
Ultimate Providence
Omni-negate Counter Trap whose discard cost is waived by Guiding Ariadne.
Drastic Drop Off
Forces opponent to discard when they add or draw a card.
extra: Level 8 Synchro summoned directly from the Extra Deck by Rebirth of Parshath.
Link-3 Parshath that discards 1 card to search The Sanctuary in the Sky or any card that mentions it.
